page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. This instance is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor to manage virtualization.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs on this instance.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for compute-heavy workloads where processing power is prioritized over large memory footprints. This resource allocation profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for parallel processing tasks that do not require massive memory caching. Recommended workloads include high-performance compute tasks, batch processing, web serving, and distributed compute nodes.
